item.title: Iran urges regional countries to prevent US use of their territory for attacks
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Foreign Ministry has defended the Armed Forces’ response to the US attacks as an exercise of the country’s inherent right to self-defense, urging regional countries to prevent Washington from using their territory and military bases for operations against Iran.

item.title: Iran, China, Russia set conditions for resumption of IAEA verification activities
item.description: London, IRNA – Iran, China and Russia say that a complete end to hostile acts, the removal of military threats and credible guarantees against further attacks are prerequisites for the full resumption of the International Atomic Energy Agency’s (IAEA) verification activities in Iran.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86326387/Iran-China-Russia-set-conditions-for-resumption-of-IAEA-verification

London, IRNA – Iran, China and Russia say that a complete end to hostile acts, the removal of military threats and credible guarantees against further attacks are prerequisites for the full resumption of the International Atomic Energy Agency’s (IAEA) verification activities in Iran.

item.title: Envoy: Iran faced military campaign, intensified economic pressure and incitement of unrest last year
item.description: New York, IRNA — Iran’s Ambassador and Chargé d’Affaires to the United Nations, Gholamhossein Darzi, says over last year, the Islamic Republic of Iran has faced a coordinated campaign involving military attacks, attempts to incite domestic unrest and exploit it for specific objectives, the imposition of unilateral coercive measures, and intensified economic pressure.
item.content:encoded:

New York, IRNA — Iran’s Ambassador and Chargé d’Affaires to the United Nations, Gholamhossein Darzi, says over last year, the Islamic Republic of Iran has faced a coordinated campaign involving military attacks, attempts to incite domestic unrest and exploit it for specific objectives, the imposition of unilateral coercive measures, and intensified economic pressure.

item.title: Araghchi: Regional security must be ensured without foreign interference
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stressed that regional security must be ensured from within the region without foreign interference, highlighting discussions in Oman on preventing renewed war and establishing an independent regional security framework.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86326300/Araghchi-Regional-security-must-be-ensured-without-foreign-interference

Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stressed that regional security must be ensured from within the region without foreign interference, highlighting discussions in Oman on preventing renewed war and establishing an independent regional security framework.

item.title: Iranian Mission in Vienna: Aggression cannot be erased by resolutions
